snippet.title: Bad Ice Cream Resort - Official Trailer (Wishlist Now / Kickstarter Coming Soon)
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5346720/Bad_Ice_Cream_Resort/
Follow our upcoming Kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/nitrome/bad-ice-cream-resort

The legendary Bad Ice Cream trilogy finally gets the long-awaited, stand-alone sequel you never knew you needed. We’ve given our hit browser arcade classic a mouth-watering upgrade, built from scratch with beautiful hand-drawn HD art.

Hit the road across an expansive Campaign Map. Play solo or in 1-4 player local co-op through branching tracks, giant bosses, and bite-sized challenges. Then, take the chaos into a frantic competitive Battle Mode across unlockable arenas.

Key Features:

- Frantic 1-4 Player Battle Mode: Grab your friends (or your worst enemies) for an absolute riot of fast-paced tactical sabotage. New arenas unlock directly via your campaign progress!

- The Tables Have Turned: Trap enemies with ice or slam them into walls to stun them for a tactical advantage, and exploit arena hazards to take them out!

- Toppings & Additives: Scramble for mid-match upgrades to turn the tide. Collect Toppings (weapon pickups)like close-combat lolly hammers to clear paths, or absorb permanent Additives (stat buffs) to boost your speed and other abilities.

- Branching Overworld Map: Explore a sprawling overworld map built for discovery. Scout hidden routes to find rare Additives, conquer secret challenges, and unearth the island’s frosty history.

- Colossal Boss Battles: Defend your turf in massive tactical showdowns! Square off against unhinged resort wildlife and the ruthless mob bosses of the Gelato Family inner circle.

- Packed With Replay Value: The campaign is just the beginning! Uncover hidden story secrets, rescue missing flavours, and hunt down mobster cash to permanently introduce wild new toppings, additives, arenas, and brutal B-side layouts into your multiplayer pool ensuring no two matches ever taste the same.

#gaming #indiegames #partygame #badicecream #kickstarter
